title: 2026 GCF homeworking FTE and office-equipment QA

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors for company reporting: Methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Homeworking conversion factors report Scope 3 emissions associated with employees working remotely from home.
Homeworking factors are published in the Homeworking worksheet of the full conversion-factor set.
Office-equipment factors were updated in 2026 to reflect the revised UK electricity factor.
The homeworking method estimates incremental energy use that would not have occurred in an office-working scenario.
All homeworking factors are expressed on a CO2e basis.
Homeworking factors are provided per full-time-equivalent working hour.
The FTE-hour basis represents one hour of work by one full-time employee.
Office-equipment assumptions include laptop or PC, monitor, phone, printer and lighting.
The workstation-energy assumption is 140 watts and lighting adds a separate 10-watt assumption.
The office-equipment assumptions are model inputs and not direct measurements of an individual employee's home.
